chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Minstrel show tour with brother Garnett
summary: A traveling minstrel show came through while brother Garnett taught football; first stops were Chattanooga and Hot Springs.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Yeah. No, no, no ... what do you call these people goin' around in show business?
Like a vaudeville show? Minstrel show?
I don't know, they just came. My brother was teaching football then and every Saturday afternoon -
What brother was that? What was his name? Which brother was teaching football?
Same one, Garnett. He taught football, he taught basketball.
Yes, G-a-r-n-e-t-t. His son's teaching that in Washington.
How long were you on the road with this group?
I don't know, but I remember the first stop was Chattanooga, Tennessee and the next one was Hot Springs, Arkansas. Sure was. This is fun; I'm having a ball. You know, bringing back the good things.
Q: That's what we want you to do.
